description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on Sport Dried fish, Mathe Seed etc.
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing and modifying special commodity levies on various imported goods. It establishes regulatory requirements for importers, specifies tariff rates for different commodity classifications, and creates exemptions for specific purposes. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
